title: CSA B52:23 Mechanical refrigeration code
purpose: Allows the acceptance of CSA B52:23, “Mechanical refrigeration code,” under the National Building Code – 2023 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).
discussion: On January 1, 2025, new standards for manufacturing with refrigerants will go into effect. These standards include prohibiting the manufacture of products containing certain hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) by January 1, 2025. HFCs are synthetic organic compounds used in air conditioning and as refrigerants. To conform to these rule changes, the 2023 edition of the CSA B52 code introduced the A2L and B2L refrigerant groups as more environmentally friendly refrigerants. Equipment manufacturers have also begun to adapt to the rule changes by re-tooling their factories to manufacture new equipment to allow for the use of these A2L and B2L refrigerant groups. Additionally, there is already equipment on the market which use the new refrigerants. The NBC(AE), however, currently references the 2018 edition of the CSA B52 Code, as per Table 1.3.1.2. of Division B. To align with the HFC prohibition and industry’s change in supply of HVAC equipment across Canada, it is necessary for the NBC(AE) to recognize the CSA B52:23 Code.
variance_text: This variance provides approximately equivalent or greater safety performance with respect to persons and property as provided for by the Safety Codes Act and the NBC(AE). 1. Conformance with CSA B52:23, “Mechanical refrigeration code,” is considered to comply with the installation standard requirements of the NBC(AE).

applies_to: This variance applies to the installation of equipment required to conform to CSA B52, as per Sentences 6.2.1.5.(1) and 9.33.5.2.(1) of the NBC(AE).
